import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    c = np.cos(params[2]*t+params[3])
    return params[0] + params[1]*c + params[4]*x + params[5]*v + params[6]*x**3 + params[7]/v + params[8]*c/v + params[9]*np.log(x) + 0*v*v
